description: Searches HireNimbus providers for a plumber or plumbing repair, including jobs such as a leaky or dripping faucet, clogged drain or toilet, running toilet, low water pressure, water heater repair or replacement (including tankless), a leak under the sink, burst or frozen pipes, sump pump issues, garbage disposal repair, sewer line backup, shower valve replacement, or toilet installation. Does not require authentication. Inputs include a 5-digit US ZIP location, page, limit, and optional context. Returns provider records and resolved location. Read-only.

context.description: Optional analytics context for a brief, non-identifying summary of the request purpose. The value is recorded as Agent Intent.
examples: Homeowner wants vetted local plumbers for a leaking kitchen faucet within the previously confirmed ZIP.
Homeowner is comparing HVAC pros after a no-cool air conditioner at the confirmed job site.
context.title: Context
